simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁגַל (H7693) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁגַל (shâgal) means to copulate with First listed occurrence: Deut 28 30.

definitions.full: H7693. shagel [ שָׁגֵל ] verb violate, ravish (Masoretes think verb obscene, and substitute שָׁכַב ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה Deut 28:30 Kt (Qr יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה ). Niph`al Imperfect 3feminine plural תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה Isa 13:16 ; Zech 14:2 women shall be ravished (both Kt; Qr תִּשְּׁכַבְנָה ). Punic < Qal passive (Ges § 52e ) Perfect 2feminine singular שֻׁגַּלְתְּ לֹא אֵיפֹה Jer 3:2 where hast thou not been ravished ? (Qr שֻׁכַּבְתְּ ).
